newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 1.024 billion yuan from 1.263 billion on Wednesday and the most active one was the 90-day contract.
Traders said the strong performance on the domestic A share market was an important factor supporting the rates and the situation was likely to continue in the next few days.
Shanghai's A share index rose 2.63 percent and Shenzhen's A index gained 1.23 percent on heavy volume.
"The strong stock market encouraged active buying from some non-banking financial institutions through the short-term financial centres," one trader said.
The rates were also supported by talk that an expected cut in bank interest rates would be suspended, a second trader said.
